entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello? I... I need some help. I'm so confused about my order and I don't know what to do.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex. I can certainly help you today. To get started, could I please have your name and order number?
It's Sarah Miller, order number 78-451-B. I bought this helmet... but the website was just so confusing. I think I need to send it back.
I understand, Sarah. I can definitely help clarify our return process for you. So I can best assist, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, no, it's not broken. It's the color. It just wasn't what I expected. The box is still unopened, I never even took it out. I was worried about the safety if I handled it too much. Can't you just help me? This is all very overwhelming.

Of course, I am happy to help. It's no problem at all. Let me just pull up your order details... one moment. Okay, I see your order for the Aura Road Helmet. It looks like it was delivered to you 85 days ago, is that correct?
Yes, I think so. Is that too long? I thought I read something about 90 days but I wasn't sure if I understood it correctly.
You are absolutely correct. Our policy for this item is a 90-day return window, so you are well within that timeframe. Since the box is unopened, I can approve a full refund for you right now.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! Thank you so much.

It's my pleasure, Sarah. I also see here that you're a VIP member with VeloFit. To make this as easy as possible for you, I'm emailing you a pre-paid return shipping label right now. As a small thank you for your loyalty, I've also added a $25 credit to your account for your next purchase.
Wow, you did all that for me? That's amazing. Thank you, Alex. You've been a huge help.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
Happy to help. Have a wonderful day, and thank you for being a VeloFit customer.
